verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI coding agent, so background cloud delegation is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows local operation: editing files in your local git repo, and a one-shot `--message` scripting mode that runs locally and exits. There is no documented isolated cloud environment or background task delegation, and the community 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a third-party add-on, not cloud execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
